metadata.status: PROPOSAL - NOT AUTHORIZED. Needs a Log Analytics workspace and a diagnostic setting sending the Automation account's JobLogs to it: new cloud resources, an approval blocker.
metadata.why: A metric alert has nothing to evaluate when no job ran at all (no TotalJob samples), so it cannot detect a monitor that never runs. A log search alert counts result rows; `summarize count()` without `by` returns one row with 0 when no job completed, and 0 < 1 fires.

properties.description: No completed qd-monitor job in 12 hours: the independent monitor itself is not running. Fires on zero rows as well as on failures.

allOf.query: AzureDiagnostics | where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.AUTOMATION" and Category == "JobLogs" | where RunbookName_s == "qd-monitor" and ResultType == "Completed" | summarize completed = count()
